First windmill variant (PRD §5.4 row 2b, §6 Variety), built to the owner's A17 answer to assets-source/refs/windmill (white, flat tile, sails turning, fantail still): a shorter, stouter smock mill (hub 10.7 m against windmill's 12.0 m, sails 6.2 m against 8.4 m): an octagonal white weatherboarded smock in six lapped courses on a buff brick octagonal base, a railed octagonal stage at the base top (deck 2.8 m up, the sails sweep 0.73 m above its rail), a domed ogee cap with a boarded petticoat and an iron ball finial, a still six-bladed fantail, and four double-shuttered patent sails (shutters both sides of the whip, six bars) on windmill's rotor contract. Its collider (the base and smock) reaches 2.77 m, inside windmill's 2.9 m footprint. Review sheet: docs/checkpoints/windmill_b/sheet.jpg. The controller records the owner's decision.
